# Encounter chronology and coverage audit

Reviewed 2026-09-07 against individual [Unbound Wiki walkthrough chapters](https://unboundwiki.com/walkthrough/) and the checked-in 2.1.1.1 workbook-derived rosters. This establishes progression separately from exact difficulty roster evidence. The wiki sometimes labels Vanilla teams but does not pin the displayed data to the same workbook version; those lists are not silently imported into versioned rosters. The Google workbook URLs could not be reopened by the web reader in this session; the September 5 export hashes in `battle-sources.md` remain the provenance of the unchanged roster file.

## Core catalogue audit

| Progression evidence | Mapped records / ordering findings |
| --- | --- |
| [Part 1](https://unboundwiki.com/walkthrough/part-1/), [2](https://unboundwiki.com/walkthrough/part-2/) | Frozen Heights rival, then Icicle Cave rival. Starter branch selected separately. |
| [4](https://unboundwiki.com/walkthrough/part-4/), [5](https://unboundwiki.com/walkthrough/part-5/) | Mirskle, then Marlon/Grunt in Cinder Volcano; Jax is an ally. |
| [7](https://unboundwiki.com/walkthrough/part-7/) | Vega, kidnapping, Ivory, then Zeph. |
| [9](https://unboundwiki.com/walkthrough/part-9/), [10](https://unboundwiki.com/walkthrough/part-10/) | Frost Mountain rival before Alice. |
| [13](https://unboundwiki.com/walkthrough/part-13/), [14](https://unboundwiki.com/walkthrough/part-14/) | Route 9 Ivory/Grunt, transformed Shadow Warriors, then Mel. Warrior exact form/stats remain unknown; their format is only labeled scripted. |
| [15](https://unboundwiki.com/walkthrough/part-15/), [16](https://unboundwiki.com/walkthrough/part-16/), [17](https://unboundwiki.com/walkthrough/part-17/) | Thundercap Marlon, Maxima, Route 12 rival. |
| [18](https://unboundwiki.com/walkthrough/part-18/) | Claydol, sequential Raikou/Entei/Suicune, then sequential Ho-Oh/Lugia. Each selected stage gets its own analysis. |
| [19](https://unboundwiki.com/walkthrough/part-19/), [20](https://unboundwiki.com/walkthrough/part-20/) | Agent Vega/Grunt, Primal Groudon, Shadow Base Zeph, then Galavan. Groudon's special control mechanics remain disclosed source caveats. |
| [25](https://unboundwiki.com/walkthrough/part-25/), [26](https://unboundwiki.com/walkthrough/part-26/) | Repeated Shadow Warrior encounters, Giratina, Vivill Aklove. Warrior record represents repeated opponents, not a single fabricated full roster. |
| [29](https://unboundwiki.com/walkthrough/part-29/), [33](https://unboundwiki.com/walkthrough/part-33/) | Big Mo, then Tessy. Optional missions between them are not assigned a mandatory position. |
| [35](https://unboundwiki.com/walkthrough/part-35/) | Cootes Bog rival, Zekrom/Reshiram double battle with Rival as partner, Ivory, Hoopa/Rayquaza double battle, Aklove, then Marlon with Rival as partner. The workbook's additional Insane Dynamax Hoopa is a separate stage after the pair. |
| [36](https://unboundwiki.com/walkthrough/part-36/), [39](https://unboundwiki.com/walkthrough/part-39/) | Benjamin, Elite Four in player-chosen order, then Jax initial championship. |

All 54 legacy roster choices map into the manifest; 15 rival choices become five selectable events with exact starter branches. No stable catalogue `order` value is used as story chronology. Difficulty variant count remains 160; reference teams were not fabricated or replaced. Full reveal exposes ordering evidence and workbook provenance. Named gap entries remain unavailable at every difficulty until exact source evidence is established.

## Completeness checklist and remaining gaps

- [x] Eight gyms, Maxima, five rival locations × three player starters, seven Shadow records, five Light of Ruin records, four initial Elite Four members and Jax are mapped to reviewed progression.
- [x] Thirteen existing scripted records audited; consecutive beasts/birds and extra Insane Hoopa are distinct stages. Crystal Peak pairs are documented double battles, correcting the older blanket sequence caveat.
- [x] Partner/source-side-note exclusion remains tested. Difficulty-specific rules and row-range source links are retained unchanged.
- [ ] Vanilla: no version-matched workbook available. Wiki provides explicitly Vanilla lists for gyms, Maxima and [initial Elite Four](https://unboundwiki.com/elite-four/), but exact version and full sets are not established. Remains unavailable; Difficult is never substituted.
- [ ] Newly discovered postgame Dynamax Claydol: encounter existence/order confirmed; exact versioned roster, moves, abilities and difficulty mechanics unverified.
- [ ] [The Rogue Electivire](https://unboundwiki.com/missions/mission-071/), [Protector of the Swamp](https://unboundwiki.com/missions/mission-051/), [The Battle of Antisis](https://unboundwiki.com/missions/mission-060/): named optional fight chains listed as gaps, with player-chosen order and no manufactured stages/sets.
- [ ] Named postgame content from the [mission inventory](https://unboundwiki.com/missions/): A Rift in Space, Shark Bait, The Endless Nightmare, The Strongest There Is (developer trainers), Gimme a V (Classic Leaders Gauntlet), Tomb Raider. Catalogue exposes unavailable entries; detailed versioned battle coverage still requires extraction/audit.
- [ ] League title-defense challengers/rematches and complete developer/optional boss rosters are not covered by the initial 54 choices. Ordinary trainers and repeatable Frontier battles remain outside this initial scope.
- [ ] Shadow Warrior has no pinned Dex form/stats; no scouting estimate is inferred. Unknown/default/uncertain move fields remain unknown. Ability/item effects, aura/shields, AI, partner behavior, evolving/devolving state and unsupported scripts are not simulated.

Software completeness is separate from source completeness. These are explicit research gaps, not evidence that every major optional/postgame fight has a verified team.
